correctness.rationale: For each n the VC upper bound follows because a shattered comparison graph cannot contain a directed-cycle orientation; the explicit low/pivot/high construction shatters an n-1-edge star while avoiding 321. Exact adaptive ranks n<=8 are obtained from the mathematically complete binary-branch recurrence on 321-avoiders, evaluated independently with permutation insertion and depth-feasibility recurrence. The complete 511-node 512-leaf tree attains depth nine at n=8 and every leaf was checked. Direct sums of avoiders are still avoiders, and their within-block decision trees concatenate, giving the stated all-s bound without numerical extrapolation. The exact large-n Ldim is not claimed.

value.rationale: The exact first strict and first two-round learning-gap transitions in a canonical Catalan permutation class are structural information: the nonadaptive dimension has a clean forest characterization while adaptive comparisons exploit constraints differently. The eight-position certificate generates a linear unbounded gap in the full class at n=8s, not merely a finite curiosity or an unrelated disjoint-domain construction. It opens quantitative questions about optimal online ranks for hereditary permutation classes.
